declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.pointSpike.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (t : ℝ), GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.pointSpike t = if t = 0 then 1 else 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.point_spike_pairings_zero
declarations.type:
(∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), ∫ (t : ℝ), GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.pointSpike t * g t = 0) ∧
  GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.pointSpike 0 ≠ 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.eq_zero_on_of_smooth_test_pairings_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ},
  Continuous f →
    IsOpen s →
      (∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ s → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) g → ∫ (t : ℝ), f t * g t = 0) →
        ∀ x ∈ s, f x = 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.exists_smooth_test_of_not_contDiffOn_two
declarations.type:
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ},
  Continuous f →
    IsOpen s →
      ¬ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f s →
        ∃ g,
          HasCompactSupport g ∧
            tsupport g ⊆ s ∧
              ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) g ∧
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => f t * g t) MeasureTheory.volume ∧ 0 < ∫ (t : ℝ), f t * g t

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.BranchSmoothTestSeparation.exists_nonzero_of_not_contDiffOn_two
declarations.type: ∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ}, ¬ContDiffOn ℝ 2 f s → ∃ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.poleVariation.eq_1
declarations.type: ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ), GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.poleVariation h t = deriv (deriv h) t - h t / 4

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.integral_second_derivative_exp
declarations.type:
∀ {h : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
    HasCompactSupport h →
      ∀ (c : ℝ), ∫ (t : ℝ), Real.exp (c * t) * deriv (deriv h) t = c ^ 2 * ∫ (t : ℝ), Real.exp (c * t) * h t

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.even_homogeneous_residual_counterexample
declarations.type:
have f := fun t => Real.exp (t / 2) + Real.exp (-t / 2);
Continuous f ∧
  Function.Even f ∧
    f 0 ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ (h : ℝ → ℝ),
        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
          HasCompactSupport h →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => f t * GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.poleVariation h t)
                MeasureTheory.volume ∧
              ∫ (t : ℝ), f t * GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.poleVariation h t = 0

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.pole_variation_exp_moment_zero._simp_1_2
declarations.type: ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : DivInvMonoid G] (a b c : G), a * (b / c) = a * b / c

declarations.name: GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.pole_variation_exp_moment_zero
declarations.type:
∀ {h : ℝ → ℝ},
  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) h →
    HasCompactSupport h →
      ∀ {c : ℝ},
        c ^ 2 = 1 / 4 →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable
              (fun t => Real.exp (c * t) * GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.poleVariation h t)
              MeasureTheory.volume ∧
            ∫ (t : ℝ), Real.exp (c * t) * GRWTSK.RiemannHypothesis.PoleAdmissibleTest.poleVariation h t = 0
